rows.behavior: kmctl summary nudge --format antigravity, given agy's PostToolUse JSON with workspacePaths[0] naming a repository whose summary is behind and run from its .agents/ folder, prints {"injectSteps":[{"systemMessage":{"systemMessage":TEXT}}]} with TEXT naming the changed concepts and both ways out; with the summary current, or bad stdin, it prints {} and exits 0.
rows.fails_when: the JSON shape differs, the repository is read from the cwd (.agents/) rather than workspacePaths, TEXT lacks the concepts or the ways out, or a quiet case prints a nudge or exits nonzero

rows.behavior: kmctl summary nudge --format opencode --path DIR reads no stdin (run with stdin left open, it returns at once), takes the repository from --path, prints the nudge text alone when the summary is behind and nothing when it is current, exiting 0.
rows.fails_when: it reads or waits on stdin, ignores --path, prints JSON or other text, prints when current, or exits nonzero

rows.behavior: apm/antigravity/.apm/hooks/hooks.json carries a PostToolUse entry running KMCTL_PINNED=1 kmctl summary nudge --format antigravity with a timeout, guarded so a missing kmctl or verb prints {} and exits 0; kmctl doctor reports it, reading APM's nested {matcher, hooks} form of the entry.
rows.fails_when: the entry, KMCTL_PINNED, the guard or the timeout is missing, a missing verb makes it fail, or doctor does not check it
rows.command: uv run pytest tests/test_summary_nudge.py tests/test_doctor.py -k antigravity_nudge -q

rows.behavior: The plugin kmctl plugin patch writes to .opencode/plugins/kmctl.js registers ctx.tool.hook("execute.after"), runs kmctl summary nudge --format opencode --path <project> with KMCTL_PINNED=1 and stdin closed, asynchronously with a timeout, and appends {type: "text", text} to event.result.content only when the output is non-empty, never throwing; run under node with a fake ctx and a real child process (a fake kmctl script that would block on an open stdin), it appends the text once when kmctl prints a nudge, returns well inside the timeout, and leaves content unchanged when kmctl prints nothing, fails, or is missing; --undo removes it; kmctl doctor reports it.
rows.fails_when: the hook is not registered, KMCTL_PINNED or --path is not passed, stdin is left open (the fake blocks to the timeout), it appends on empty output or a failure, throws, or doctor does not check it

rows.behavior: docs/reference/commands.md, the nudge's decision and docs/how-to/install-kmctl-with-apm.md name the Antigravity and OpenCode nudges, and the decision notes that agy documents PostToolUse as expecting {} and kmctl relies on injectSteps reaching the model there (spike 1).
rows.fails_when: a page does not name a harness's nudge or the decision omits the agy caveat

rows.behavior: The full suite and every tier pass.
rows.command: uv run pytest -q -m "not integration or integration"
